def calc_primes(n: int; var a:array<int>) {
    a |> clear
    a |> reserve(n)

    a |> push(2)
    if n == 1
        return
    a |> push(3)

    let gen <- generator<int>() <| $()
        var t = 6
        while true
            yield t-1
            yield t+1
            t += 6
        return false

    var iterVal: int
    while length(a) < n
        next(gen, iterVal)
        var simple = true
        for prim in a
            if iterVal % prim == 0
                simple = false
                break
            if prim * prim > iterVal
                break
        if simple
            a |> push(iterVal)
}
